mapper.sql: id,storage_receipt_id,material_id, quantity,unit,batch, case_no,associated_no,valid_time, create_by,create_name,create_time, update_by,update_name,update_time, del_flag
mapper.select: SELECT wsri.id, wsri.storage_receipt_id, wsri.material_id, wsri.quantity, wsri.unit, wsri.batch, wsri.case_no, wsri.associated_no, wsri.valid_time FROM wms_storage_receipt_info wsri LEFT JOIN wms_storage_receipt wsr ON wsr.id = wsri.storage_receipt_id WHERE wsr.del_flag = 0 and wsr.`status`!= 5 and wsri.case_no = #{caseNo} and wsri.del_flag = 0 order by wsri.valid_time desc limit 1

SELECT IF( HOUR ( a.affirm_time ) >= 8, DATE_FORMAT( a.affirm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ), DATE_SUB( DATE_FORMAT( a.affirm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ), INTERVAL 1 DAY ) ) AS valid_time, b.quantity FROM wms_storage_receipt a LEFT JOIN wms_storage_receipt_info b ON a.id = b.storage_receipt_id where a.del_flag = 0 and b.del_flag = 0 AND a.`status` = 1 AND a.type = #{typeId} AND b.material_id = #{materialId} AND a.affirm_time >= #{startTime} AND a.affirm_time < #{endTime}
